task.description: Design the fix for ISS-0147 per the ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis. Type E prose design.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 4 GH #374 acceptance criteria

result.summary: Wrote src/design/python_interpreter_resolution.md (Type E). Replaces name-based interpreter selection with an ordered candidate list (BPM_PYTHON authoritative, repo .venv, VIRTUAL_ENV, python3, python) where each candidate must pass a liveness probe (-c writing sentinel BPM_PY_OK, exit 0) before acceptance. The probe is what rejects the alias stub. New module tests/integration/python_interp.zig, placed beside helpers.zig so it needs no build.zig module wiring. Test assertions are unchanged -- the fix restores the measurement rather than suppressing it.
